/*
    STA_Partner: mapping tên khách trạm cân -> CRM_Partner.PartnerID
    STA_Partner.id = CRM_Partner.PartnerID
    Nhiều STA_Partner.ten có thể cùng 1 id
*/

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Partner_GET]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_GET]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_GET]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Select
        STA_Partner.ten,
        STA_Partner.id
    From
        STA_Partner
    Where
        STA_Partner.ten = @ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Partner_GETALL]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_GETALL]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_GETALL]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Select
        STA_Partner.ten,
        STA_Partner.id
    From
        STA_Partner
    Order By
        STA_Partner.ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Partner_SEARCH]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_SEARCH]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_SEARCH]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Select
        STA_Partner.ten,
        STA_Partner.id,
        CRM_Partner.PartnerCode,
        CRM_Partner.PartnerName
    From
        STA_Partner
        Left Join CRM_Partner On CRM_Partner.PartnerID = STA_Partner.id
    Order By
        STA_Partner.ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Partner_ADD]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_ADD]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_ADD]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250),
    @id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Insert Into STA_Partner (
        ten,
        id
    )
    Values (
        @ten,
        @id
    )
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Partner_EDIT]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_EDIT]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_EDIT]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250),
    @id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Update
        STA_Partner
    Set
        id = @id
    Where
        ten = @ten
END
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[STA_Partner_DELETE]') AND type IN (N'P', N'PC'))
    DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_DELETE]
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_Partner_DELETE]
    @ten NVARCHAR(250)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    Delete From
        STA_Partner
    Where
        ten = @ten
END
GO

/*
    Bảng mapping: STA_Partner.ten (tên khách trạm) -> STA_Partner.id = CRM_Partner.PartnerID
    Nhiều ten có thể cùng 1 id.

    Script store + grid:
      - STA_Partner.sql
      - STA_Partner_GridColumn.sql
*/

SELECT TOP (1000) [ten]
      ,[id]
  FROM [dbo].[STA_Partner]

/*
    Cấu hình lưới STA_Partner
    Chạy SAU STA_Partner.sql
*/

Delete From SYS_GridColumn
Where QueryName = 'STA_Partner'
GO

Insert Into SYS_GridColumn (
    QueryName,
    FieldName,
    Caption,
    Editable,
    Visible,
    VisibleIndex,
    FormatString,
    Banded,
    FixedType,
    IsWithinConfig,
    FilterCondition,
    DefaultValue,
    FromColumnOfItem
)
Values
    ('STA_Partner', 'ten', N'Tên khách trạm', 1, 1, 1, '', '', Null, 0, '', '', ''),
    ('STA_Partner', 'id',  N'Khách hàng',     1, 1, 2, '', '', Null, 0, '', '', '')
GO

Đã làm **STA_Partner** mapping **CRM_Partner** theo đúng cơ chế STA_Item (không có service).

### Database (`sta-mapping`)
| File | Nội dung |
|------|----------|
| `sta-partner.sql` | Mô tả bảng mapping |
| `STA_Partner.sql` | Store GET / GETALL / SEARCH / ADD / EDIT / DELETE |
| `STA_Partner_GridColumn.sql` | Cột lưới: `ten` = Tên khách trạm, `id` = Khách hàng |

`STA_Partner.id` = `CRM_Partner.PartnerID` (nhiều `ten` có thể cùng 1 `id`).

### Code
- `STA_Partner.cs` + Base đã có sẵn (gọi store trực tiếp)
- `frmSTAPartner` — lookup `CRM_PartnerService`, chọn hàng loạt qua `CRMManager.Partner.frmPartnerSelect`

### Chạy SQL theo thứ tự
1. `STA_Partner.sql`
2. `STA_Partner_GridColumn.sql`

Build `StationObject` + `StationManager` đã OK.
